signal: Uncountable raised a $27M Series A and announced a strategic collaboration with DuPont to advance AI-ready labs

email.body1:
Ryan, saw Uncountable raised a $27M Series A and just announced a strategic collaboration with DuPont on AI-ready labs.

Scaling that fast usually means more enterprise R&D accounts in play than the team can cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Uncountable off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ryan, quick follow-up for Uncountable.

Post-raise and with a marquee DuPont win, expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Uncountable needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ryan, last bit of proof for Uncountable.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Uncountable's reply rate likely compares to other industrial-SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ryan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an industrial-R&D motion? I'll tailor it to Uncountable either way.
